lastCompletedStory.title: Add validate-agents-md.ts doc-as-code checker with unit tests

openQuestions: Running `bun scripts/validate-agents-md.ts` for real against the live repo currently fails: the corpus (root CLAUDE.md, scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md, .claude/agents/*.md) is heavy with bare-filename shorthand (`prd.json`, `handoff.json`, `worker-report.json`, `review-report.json`, `patterns.md`, `journal.md`, `run.ts`, `setup.ts` referenced without their real directory prefix) that does not resolve at repo root. US-001's oracles only cover injected-fixture unit tests, so this was left unreconciled. US-003 (wiring into check:all) will need to either fix these docs to use fully-qualified paths or extend KNOWN_MISSING before the gate can go green in CI.

.claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md has a real, pre-existing malformed-markdown bug: a stray unmatched single backtick near "Keep entries concise -- `<200 words" (missing its closing backtick), which desyncs backtick-span pairing for the rest of that file. Not fixed here (self-hosting file, out of this story's AC scope) -- flagging for a follow-up fix.

.claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md references `.githooks/**` in its self-hosting constraint list, but no `.githooks/` directory exists in this repo (hooks live under `.claude/hooks/`); may be genuine staleness worth a follow-up doc fix.
nextStoryContext: US-002 (Freeze COMMANDS array exact count and membership) and US-003 (wire validate-agents-md as check:all gate #12) build on this. COMMANDS is exported from index.ts:2858 (const array, `as const`). validate-agents-md.ts's public API: resolveScanTargets(cwd), validateDocs(docs, options) -> {findings, unusedKnownMissing}, KNOWN_MISSING (glob-capable {pattern,reason}[]). The KNOWN_MISSING list currently only covers the AC5-named runtime artifacts plus two slash-command entries (/cam-*, /exit) discovered as false positives; it does NOT attempt to reconcile the pervasive bare-filename doc-staleness noted in openQuestions above.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed scanSync({cwd, dot, onlyFiles}) semantics and Glob#match(str) dotfile behavior match the implementation (dot:true + onlyFiles:false needed for directory/dotfile resolution; match() treats an explicit dot-prefixed pattern segment as an intentional target).
